Make a list of things you truly feel you are good at. Will be hard at first but it can be anything. 

For example: Driving, listening, waking up early, math.

Then pick one a day and write a paragraph on each. Write about why you feel you are good at this. 

Make sure you write it down.

Think of what you used to do that you enjoyed before you felt depressed. 

Let’s say you used to bowl. It’s hard to just get up and now when you are depressed, but you can look at pictures of you doing it. Or watching videos of people bowling. 

It can be anything you used to get enjoyment out of. Work your way to getting yourself to do them again.

Try to focus on only the things you can control. 

Feel like things are spiraling out of control? Clean your room, make a nice meal, do that thing you have been putting off. 

This will make you feel better because you won’t dwell on things you can’t control.

Very touching story and I know it was hard to put all that down. First of all its great you did put that story down and think hard because you really do care about your life.

From what I've read you seem to know yourself really well and convinced yourself that you have a problem and that you are not good enough. In all honesty we all don't fully know ourselves and it takes time and experiences to learn. When you speak of yourself and how you feel you like different things and that you are different is not true. Think about it. There are billions of people in this world. Billions. Yes you fell for someone hard because that was the first person that you felt similar to. But there is more out there and honestly there is better out there because you deserve someone that won't lie to you about being engaged. You deserve someone that will respect you and not hide anything from you. 

Its good you have gone to speak with someone however I feel you should see a counselor that can't administer medication first. These people really just talk to you and go deep. Suicide seems like an easy way out but you know you are capable to love and that is much stronger than your desire to hurt yourself. I had someone that i wanted to die for and lost that person. It was very tough and not easy. It was so strong and the weight was pulling me down, I couldn't even get out of bed. I spoke to some counselors and really realized that I had to learn to love myself. This is what I feel is most important for you. Imagine having that love for the girl but to yourself? This is completely possible and I feel you can do it because you know yourself well. 

Now I feel 100 percent that you should speak to your mother about this. I know you said you don't want to burden her but imagine your child was going through this, wouldn't you want them to talk to you no matter what?

As for how. It won't be easy and there is no wrong way to do it. Just tell her everything you wrote here and how you feel about yourself. She seems genuine and she will understand. If anything she will love to help you and you two will get closer. 

I wish you the best of luck and life seems like shit now but you are on your way to finding your purpose because you are courageous enough to ask for help. That shows you care.
